basis: Pinned local collection; exact remaining-name membership from the support audit

lanes.label: Existing foundations: pattern, value, filter or sequencing extensions
Add or complete a game subsystem
Card-specific design or manual rules review

groups.label: Damage, healing, Armor and board stats
groups.work: Extend numeric expressions, target-dependent branches, tribal filters and compound stat effects.

groups.label: Draw, discard and hand/deck movement
groups.work: Extend existing zone operations: draws, burns, ordering, bottom-of-deck placement and hand replacement.

groups.label: Summons, recruits and token definitions
groups.work: Add exact token definitions, variable summon stats, filtered recruitment and placement rules. Generated minion abilities need their own coverage.

groups.label: Generated cards and named card pools
groups.work: Define precise named/tribal/class/school pools and generated-card metadata; implement any required token abilities.

groups.label: Card costs, mana and ordinary discounts
groups.work: Extend cost-setting, discount duration/counts, mana caps and multi-card cost relationships.

groups.label: Discover and other player choices
groups.work: Extend existing choices with multiple selections, target/choice relationships, hidden selections and result-dependent riders.

groups.label: Copies, transformations, swaps and control
groups.work: Extend physical-card copying, stat preservation, owner/controller identity and linked swaps or transformations.

groups.label: Deathrattles, resurrection and remembered victims
groups.work: Track the exact destroyed/discarded/chosen minion and carry that identity into later Deathrattles or resurrection.

groups.label: Weapons, forced attacks and combat restrictions
groups.work: Extend weapon effects, durability, forced combat, repeated attacks and special attack restrictions.

groups.label: History, thresholds and scaling conditions
groups.work: Extend public history, while-held counters, distinct schools/types, spent mana, starting decks and previous-turn queries.

groups.label: Delayed effects and start/end-of-turn triggers
groups.work: Extend scheduler timing, duration, expiry, ownership and source survival checks; some cases need persistent event listeners too.

groups.label: Auras, listeners and ongoing board effects
groups.work: Add recomputed auras or event listeners with source binding, Silence, zone changes and cleanup.

groups.label: Lasting rules and game-wide replacements
groups.work: Add persistent rules that modify future cards, draws, summons, damage, healing or other actions.

groups.label: Spell Damage and spell-only modifiers
groups.work: Apply Spell Damage, next-spell bonuses, spell Lifesteal and other spell modifiers consistently across all damage paths.

groups.label: Automatic casting and replaying spells/Battlecries
groups.work: Resolve nested casts, legal random targets, replay history, repeats, choices and recursion limits.

groups.label: Hero powers, upgrades and replacements
groups.work: Support additional powers, power copying/upgrades, refreshes, damage history, discounts and power-specific triggers.

groups.label: Secrets, traps and Counter effects
groups.work: Implement hidden zones, trigger windows, ownership/privacy and Counter resolution.

groups.label: Cast-when-drawn cards and deck hazards
groups.work: Implement draw replacement and injected Bombs, Portals, Fragments, Curses and other self-casting tokens.

groups.label: Corpses and Death Knight rune resources
groups.work: Track Corpse creation/spending and rune-dependent card behavior.

groups.label: Health/Armor costs and alternate payment rules
groups.work: Extend payment validation, spending order, duration, safety and reductions when cards cost something other than mana.

groups.label: Named progression families
groups.work: Shared progression for C’Thun, Jade Golems, Galakrond, Librams, Relics, curses and other named families; each family is separately tagged.

groups.label: Quests, Excavation and expansion objectives
groups.work: Implement objective counters, reward pools and action systems such as Excavate, Herald, Imbue and Ritual.

groups.label: Extra keywords and attached mechanics
groups.work: A simple Battlecry is still blocked when the same printing also needs Tradeable, Combo, Rewind, Infuse, Forge or another unsupported mechanic. See exact keyword tags.

groups.label: Dormant, locations and board-state systems
groups.work: Implement Dormant/wake timers, location rules, Starships, Colossal appendages and other nonstandard board objects.

groups.label: Custom cards, construction and minigames
groups.work: Define custom choice trees, constructed cards, puzzles, auctions, trials and special minigames rather than substituting a generic random card.

groups.label: Turns, starting decks and match-wide changes
groups.work: Review extra turns, starting-game effects, turn control, hero/deck swaps, alternate wins and Commander-specific interactions.

groups.label: Special scripts and unresolved rules
groups.work: Named or ambiguous effects without a safely identified shared implementation. Requires an explicit per-card rules decision.
